Guide to Benefits

Example Bank Everyday Visa Card. This guide describes the benefits that come with your card. Keep it with your other important documents.

The benefits in this guide are provided by Example Bank and its fictional benefit administrator. They apply to purchases made with your Everyday Visa card account in good standing. Example Bank is a fictional bank used only in software tests.

Extended Warranty Protection

Extended Warranty Protection extends the time period of the original manufacturer's written U.S. warranty by one additional year, up to $10,000 per claim.

Eligible items must be purchased entirely with your card. Warranties of more than three years are not eligible. You must file a claim within 90 days of the failure, with the receipt, the card statement and the original warranty.

Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver

Decline the rental company's collision damage waiver and pay for the entire rental with your card. This coverage is secondary to your personal auto insurance.

It covers theft and damage to most rental cars for rental periods of up to 15 consecutive days in the United States and 31 days abroad. Exotic cars, antique cars and large vans are excluded.

Claims and general provisions

To file a claim, call the benefit administrator within 60 days of the incident and send the requested documents within 120 days. Coverage applies only to the cardmember and, where stated, to authorized users of the account. Benefits are subject to the terms of this guide and may change with notice.

These benefits don't cover losses caused by war, fraud, normal wear and tear, or items left unattended in a public place. Example Bank is a fictional bank used only in software tests, and nothing in this guide describes real coverage.
